usage.finalMessage:
I added `run-interest`, which charges DEC-B14 collection interest once per invoice: 1% of the invoice amount, when the invoice is unpaid more than 60 days after its due date. Charged interest counts toward what's outstanding and the customer's balance, `help` lists the command right after `run-late-fees`, and `dotnet test Billing.slnx` passes 9/9. Everything is committed.
Two open questions are recorded: interest is charged to nonprofits because no source exempts them, though late fees skip them. Also, `show` keeps its format, but its outstanding figure now includes interest, so its listed parts won't add up to that total.

OUTCOME: completed
